items.label: f04-unique-by-message
items.front: Why is the staff-email duplicate check fragile?
items.back: It detects uniqueness by matching 'unique' or User_email_key in the error message text, the same fragility the appointment path avoids with typed Prisma error metadata.

items.label: f02-single-blocked-reason
items.front: What does reason: 'blocked' on a closed slot tell the UI?
items.back: Nothing specific: every closed slot gets 'blocked' whether it is outside working hours, in time off or already booked, so the UI cannot tell them apart.

items.label: f03-race-safe-past-cancel
items.front: How to stop clients cancelling finished appointments, race-safely
items.back: Enforce 'only before startsAt' either in cancelAppointment after the scoped read, or better by adding startsAt: { gt: now } to the conditional updateMany predicate so the check and the write are one statement.

items.label: f01-validation-vs-availability
items.front: Malformed vs unavailable in the scheduling policy
items.back: An increasing, well-formed interval can legitimately be unavailable (false). A zero step or invalid timestamp is malformed and must fail promptly with a validation error, never an infinite loop or an apparently valid empty preview.
